query:
# Candidates for a clean default consequence: spouse triples with no reverse
# triple where both parties are directly instances of human (Q5). Driven from
# two small sets of subjects so that the query finishes: astronauts (P106
# Q11631) and winners of the Nobel Prize in Physics (P166 Q38104). A sample
# for choosing one case, not a count.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?a ?aLabel ?b ?bLabel WHERE {
  { ?a wdt:P106 wd:Q11631 . } UNION { ?a wdt:P166 wd:Q38104 . }
  ?a wdt:P26 ?b .
  ?a wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  ?b wdt:P31 wd:Q5 .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?b wdt:P26 ?a }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
ORDER BY ?a ?b
LIMIT 50
